title: Frontier
description: browse's codomain: the one-step generated frontier of a vault topic  -  the proof-tree nodes its node generates (its immediate object/morphism/joint children). The proof-tree reading of `attend` (choosing a fiber and reading what it generates in one step). $id is the bare package-rooted descent path.

topic.description: the topic whose frontier was generated (empty string = the vault root)

nodes.description: the generated frontier: the vault nodes the topic generates in one step

VaultNode.description: a resolved vault node (the carrier organizing/knowledge-vault/node, kept structurally here so the frontier is self-typing).
